members.note: Hidden inside: bon (good) + jour (day).
Hidden inside: tous (all) + jours (days), so 'all days' means always.
le jour + -nal: a paper that comes out every day.
le journal + -iste: the person who writes for the newspaper.
Hidden inside: bon (good) + soir (evening).
Hidden inside: bien (well) + tôt (early), so 'quite soon'.
Hidden inside: bien (well) + venue (come, from venir).
re- (again, back) + venir: to come back.
Hidden inside: re- (again) + voir (to see): 'until we see each other again'.
comme (like, as) + -ment: 'in what way', so how.
Hidden inside: pour (for) + quoi (what): 'for what?'
Hidden inside: pour (for) + tant (so much).
de + rien (nothing): 'it was nothing'.
mal (badly) is inside la maladie: being unwell.
com- (together) + prendre: to take the meaning in.
ap- + prendre: to take knowledge in.
From prendre (past form pris/prise): where the plug takes power.
entre + prise (from prendre): something you take on, a business.
a- (toward) + porter: to carry something here.
em- (away) + porter: to carry something away.
Hidden inside: porte (carries) + feuille (sheet): it carries your bills.
From boire: something you drink.
Hidden inside: pour (for) + boire (to drink): money 'for a drink'.
passer + -age: a place to pass across, here for piétons (walkers).
Hidden inside: passe (pass) + port: the paper that lets you pass.
dé- + part (from partir): the moment you leave.
From arriver: the moment you arrive.
From entrer: the dish you 'enter' the meal with.
arrêter minus -er: the place where the bus stops.
rencontrer minus -r gives the noun: a meeting.
From répondre: what you give when you answer.
The verb se souvenir used as a noun: something you remember.
The verb devoir (must) used as a noun: work you must do.
la cuisine + -er makes the verb: to do what happens in a kitchen.
la cuisine + -ier: the person who cooks.
vendre + -eur: the person who sells.
le boulanger + -ie: the baker's shop.
la pharmacie + -ien: the person who works in the pharmacy.
compter + -able: the person who counts the money.
le travail + -ler makes the verb: to work.
From étudier + -ant: the person who studies.
re- (again) + cherche (from chercher): searching again and again.
From donner: 'the given things', the facts you have.
sou- (under, a little) + rire: a small, quiet laugh.
Past form of ouvrir: opened.
Past form of fermer: closed.
in- (not) + utile: not useful.
utile + -iser makes the verb: to make use of.
im- (not) + possible.
im- (not) + patient.
im- (not) + poli.
mé- (badly, not) + content.
aimer + -able: easy to like.
Same root as aimer: a friend is someone you like.
l'ami + -tié: the feeling between friends.
in- (not) + connu (known, from connaître): a person you don't know.
Same lav- as laver: the basin where you wash.
lave (washes) + linge (laundry).
lave (washes) + vaisselle (dishes).
From sec (fem. sèche) + -resse: a long dry time.
sèche (dries, from sec) + linge (laundry).
Noun from the same root as chaud: the heat itself.
From chauffer (to heat, from chaud) + -age: the heating.
grand + mère (mother).
grand + père (father).
grands + parents: the grand-mère and grand-père together.
petite + fille (daughter).
petit + fils (son).
petit (small) + pois (pea).
petit (small) + déjeuner: the 'small lunch' of the morning.
aller (going) + retour (coming back).
permis (permit) + de conduire (to drive).
super- (extra big) + marché.
centre (center) + ville.
station + service: a station that services cars.
arc (bow) + en + ciel: a bow in the sky.
fruits + de mer (of the sea).
pomme + de terre: 'apple of the earth'.
la poule + -et (small): a young chicken, now chicken meat.
le poivre + -on: the pepper you eat as a vegetable.
serviette + de table: the cloth for the table.
Same chauss- root as la chaussure: what goes on your foot first.
Same chauss- root as la chaussure: a soft shoe for home.
sous (under) + vêtement: clothing worn underneath.
sous (under) + sol (ground): the floor below ground.
la porte + -ail: a big door, a gate.
sac (bag) + poubelle.
sac (bag) + à main (for the hand).
tourne (turns) + vis (screw).
l'oreille + -er: where you lay your ear.
boucle (loop) + d'oreille (of the ear).
la dent + -iste: the tooth doctor.
Same méd- root as le médecin: what the doctor gives you.
public + -ité: making something known to the public.
auto (car) + route: a road for cars.
distributeur (dispenser) + de billets (of banknotes).
office (office) + de tourisme.
mot (word) + de passe (to pass): the word that lets you in.
le pays + -age: what a piece of country looks like.
em- + bouteille + -age: cars stuck like in a bottle's neck.
Same root as l'hôte: the place that hosts travelers.
From le mari + -age: becoming husband and wife.
pré- (before) + nom: the name that comes first.
la terre + -asse: a flat piece of ground by the house.
le champ + -ignon: something that grows in fields.
é- + clair: a sudden light in the sky.
con- + gél (gel, frost) + -ateur: the machine that freezes.
lun (from la lune) + di (day): the moon's day.
le vent + -ilateur: the machine that makes wind.
Same mont- as monter: what you climb up.
cinq + -ante: five tens.
quatre becomes quar- + -ante: four tens.
